title: Lahaina long-term recovery plan
summary: As of October 9, 2024, County, state and federal partners were drafting a long-term recovery plan. It included a project for a rebuild Lahaina plan, to be done within two years.

timeline.text: The long-term recovery plan includes a project for a rebuild Lahaina plan, to be done within two years.

fromCommunityMeetings.who: County Planning Department Long Range Planning Division administrator
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: ʻOla Lahaina will be the main resource for staying informed on the latest in-person and online engagement events, accessing feedback from fellow community members and contributing to drafting Lahaina's long-term recovery plan.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Introduces the Ola Lahaina website as the main way residents can help shape the Lahaina long-term recovery plan.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: February 21, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: County Planning Department Long Range Planning Division administrator
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: We are here three days a week for this month. Starting March 1st, we'll be here on Wednesdays from 9 to 3. So please come and visit us.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Gives in-person times at the Disaster Recovery Center for residents to give input on the long-term recovery plan.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: February 21, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: County Managing Director helping lead the Office of Recovery
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: So, in the coming weeks ahead, likely sometime in February, we're going to be getting on kind of more formal community engagement processes. What that could look like is public comment sessions where we'll have possible town hall meetings or separate sessions to provide feedback
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Gives the expected timing and format for formal community input on the recovery planning process.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: January 24, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: A Lahaina resident living on Hawaiian Home Lands
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: We can rebuild within the 120 setback for the generational Hawaiian homes that were on the beaches on Front Street. It's our just hope. Because right now under the setback laws and the destruction, 100% destruction, I can't build anything within 120 feet of the shoreline.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Shows how shoreline setback rules affect families hoping to rebuild generational homes on Front Street, a question officials said is a hot topic for recovery planning.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: January 24, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: County of Maui Managing Director leading the Office of Recovery
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: about the public sentiment analysis that was done in coordination with our FEMA partners, about all the testimony and feedback that we've been hearing from the community, Ideas, policy suggestions, and things of that nature, as well as helping you folks understand what the engagement process will look like in that long-term recovery plan and how you can stay engaged throughout it to help make decisions for the future of Lahaina.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: In January 2024 the county said it would soon share a FEMA-assisted analysis of community feedback and explain how residents can take part in shaping the Lahaina long-term recovery plan.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting: January 17, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: Acting County Managing Director leading the Office of Recovery
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: That recovery needs assessment will be used to develop strategies and implementing projects that will be able to actually undertake a lot of the recovery efforts that our community has desired.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Explains that a recovery needs assessment, built from community testimony, would feed the strategies and projects in the recovery plan.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting of January 10, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.who: Acting County Managing Director leading the Office of Recovery
fromCommunityMeetings.quote: As a part of this whole process, we'll develop a long-term recovery plan that will help to guide the efforts of all of our projects and partners.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: In January 2024, the county said a long-term recovery plan would guide all recovery projects and partners and would include community feedback.

source.title: Lahaina Disaster Recovery Update Meeting of January 10, 2024

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: So one of the things that we're doing is working with the county on a long-term recovery. And it's provided support from many different agencies in different areas to focus on areas such as community planning, natural and cultural resources, health and social sciences, housing, infrastructure systems, and economic recovery.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: FEMA's regional administrator describes the early federal-county partnership on long-term wildfire recovery planning and the areas it would cover.
